# Recap Rules Checklist: Daily Chat Digest

**Purpose**: Requirements-quality review of which messages count as typed personal news, who is named in silence notes, how full-day silence counts run, and when a day is only partly visible
**Created**: 2026-10-27
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are the message kinds that count as a member having typed text enumerated together with the kinds that do not, including replies, forwards, media captions, service or membership notices, and this bot's own messages? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005, Spec §FR-008]
- [x] CHK002 Is "a member of the chat that day" defined for the silence roster, including someone who joined or left during that Minsk day? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011, Gap]
- [x] CHK003 Does the spec separate two outcomes for a message deleted or edited before midnight: whether it may appear as personal news, and whether it still counts as that member having typed? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005, Spec §User Story 1 scenario 3, Gap]
- [x] CHK004 Are the conditions for a fully visible day, a partly visible day, and a day that could not be read at all each defined? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012, Spec §Assumptions, Gap]
- [x] CHK005 Does the spec require that a later attempt for the same recap day leave each member's full-day silence count unchanged? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011, Spec §FR-013, Gap]
- [x] CHK006 Are silence-count rules specified for a member who leaves and later rejoins, including whether the stored run continues? [Gap, Spec §FR-011]
- [x] CHK007 Does the spec state whether a command such as `/logs` counts as text that member typed for the silence mark? [Gap, Spec §FR-005, Spec §FR-011]
- [x] CHK008 Does the spec require silence names and counts to follow the day rules, rather than leaving them to the narrative of personal news? [Gap, Spec §FR-003, Spec §FR-011]
- [x] CHK009 Is it specified that every qualifying silent member is named, with no omitted remainder, and that a recap which does not fit in one message still carries those names and counts? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004, Spec §FR-011]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK010 Is "notable personal event" bounded by family, health, relationships, moves, jobs, and achievements, with a stated contrast to plans, jokes, greetings, and small talk? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003]
- [x] CHK011 Is "the same personal event" defined so the requirement to tell it once can be applied when the wording differs? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases, Ambiguity]
- [x] CHK012 Is "related events about the same person" defined for grouping, including an event that involves more than one person? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003, Ambiguity]
- [x] CHK013 Is "silent for a long time" tied to a numeric full-day count, rather than left as a judgment? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011]
- [x] CHK014 Does "consecutive fully visible Minsk days" say whether a partly visible day between two fully visible silent days breaks the run or leaves the count unchanged? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-011, Spec §FR-012]
- [x] CHK015 Is "typed no text" distinguished from "no notable personal news," so small talk still counts as that member having written? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005, Spec §FR-006, Spec §FR-011]
- [x] CHK016 Is the label used when a member is named specified for a first name, a last name, a username, or none of these? [Gap, Spec §FR-011]
- [x] CHK017 Is the language of eligible source text specified, given that the recap itself must be Russian? [Gap, Spec §FR-003, Spec §FR-010]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK018 Do the clarifications, FR-011, and acceptance scenarios 11 and 12 agree that a count of 1 omits the long-silence sentence and a count of 2 or more includes it? [Consistency, Spec §Clarifications, Spec §FR-011]
- [x] CHK019 Are forwards and media captions excluded both from personal news and from the mark that the member has written, in every section that mentions them? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §FR-011]
- [x] CHK020 Does a fully visible day with no notable events and no silent member stay a no-post in FR-002, FR-006, acceptance scenario 4, and the copy contract? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002, Spec §FR-006, contracts/telegram-copy.md]
- [x] CHK021 Does a day the bot could not read at all require one failure explanation and no silence list in both FR-012 and the edge cases? [Consistency, Spec §FR-012, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK022 When the only new fact is that part of the day was not visible, does FR-002 still require a recap while FR-006's no-filler rule stays limited to fully visible days? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002, Spec §FR-006]
- [x] CHK023 Do the spec's count rules and the copy contract agree on the Russian line for one full day, for two or more full days, for a member with no visible messages, and for an unread remainder? [Consistency, Spec §FR-011, Spec §FR-012, contracts/telegram-copy.md]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK024 Can SC-005 be evaluated with the member roster, the meaning of "typed," and consecutiveness across a partly visible day all specified? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005]
- [x] CHK025 Does SC-002 limit its 90% denominator to notable personal events from text members typed themselves, and place forwards, captions, plans, jokes, greetings, and small talk outside that count? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002, Spec §FR-003]
- [x] CHK026 Is "a couple of minutes" in FR-004 aligned with the under-2-minutes measure in SC-003, including a recap that continues in more than one message? [Measurability, Spec §FR-004, Spec §SC-003]

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK027 Are requirements specified for one fully visible day that mixes a notable event a member typed, small talk, a notable event that appears only as a forward or caption, and a member who typed nothing? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 1 Independent Test]
- [x] CHK028 Are requirements specified for a partly visible day that still contains notable typed events, including that those events are recapped and that no full-day count changes? [Coverage, Spec §FR-012, Spec §User Story 1 scenario 13]
- [x] CHK029 Are requirements specified both for the first fully visible silent day when no earlier mark exists and for the second consecutive fully visible silent day? [Coverage, Spec §FR-011, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK030 After a member types on a fully visible day, do the requirements omit that member from the silence lines and make the next silent full day count as 1? [Coverage, Spec §FR-011, Spec §User Story 1 scenario 11]
- [x] CHK031 When one event is both typed by a member and present as a forward, do the requirements call for it once, and only from the typed text? [Coverage, Spec §FR-005, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK032 Are membership notices specified as neither personal news nor typed text, so a person who only joined or left can still be a silence subject on a fully visible day? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-008, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK033 Does the spec define which senders are silence subjects, including this bot and any other non-human sender? [Gap, Spec §Key Entities]
- [x] CHK034 Is a message at exactly 00:00 Minsk assigned to one of the two calendar days for both personal news and the silence mark? [Edge Case, Spec §Assumptions, Gap]
- [x] CHK035 Is the order of silence lines and partial-visibility lines specified? [Gap, Spec §FR-011, contracts/telegram-copy.md]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK036 Is midnight in Minsk the only day boundary used both for which events belong in the recap and for which days enter a silence run? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions, Spec §FR-002]
- [x] CHK037 Is the limit that unobserved members cannot be named recorded as an assumption on the "every member" rule, rather than left only in research? [Assumption, Spec §Clarifications, Spec §Assumptions, Gap]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [x] CHK038 Do the clarifications, which require every member who typed nothing to be named, agree with the roster limit that people the bot has never been shown are omitted? [Conflict, Spec §Clarifications, research.md Member roster]
- [x] CHK039 Does the partial-day sentence apply only when part of the day could not be read, or also when retrieval sets truncation on a day the bot did read? [Conflict, Spec §FR-012, contracts/telegram-copy.md, contracts/rag.md]
- [x] CHK040 When that truncation is treated as partial visibility, do silence counts stay frozen under FR-012, or does a fully read day still increment and reset them? [Conflict, Spec §FR-012, data-model.md, contracts/rag.md]
